rec.name: Shop-the-Look Hotspots in PDP Gallery Image
rec.status: Built — delivered (documentation and product image requested)

what.text: A cross-sell module placed inside the PDP image gallery. One gallery slide shows a model image with up to 5 round white hotspot dots over the clothing and accessories. On hover (desktop) or tap (mobile), a black preview card opens next to the dot. It shows the product thumbnail, name (truncated), a short description, and the price (sale price if discounted). The whole card links to that product's page. Nothing is added to the cart automatically. The slide is inserted at a configurable position (1–4) in the product media swiper.

why.text: Shoppers see the outfit on a model and can discover matching items in context, without leaving the image or searching. This is a shop-the-look pattern that raises AOV and items per order by turning inspiration into low-friction cross-sell. The preview shows price and name up front, so the click-through is informed. Linking to the product page (not auto add-to-cart) keeps the user in control and avoids pushy behaviour. The last hotspot's card is open by default, which acts as a visual cue that the dots are interactive.

how.text: 1) In main-product.liquid, add a schema block 'CRO | Crosssale in Image' (type cro_crosssale_items, limit 1) with settings: slide position (range 1–4), an image picker, and up to 5 items. Each item has a product picker plus top % and left % position fields. 2) Create the snippet ed_cro_cross_sale_in_product_image.liquid. It renders the image in a swiper-slide wrapper with absolutely positioned hotspot dots (white 14px dot with a translucent halo that darkens on hover). Each dot has a black card (50px thumbnail, title truncated to 18 characters, description truncated to 48 characters, price, compare-at handling) linking to item_product.url. Inline JS toggles a 'visible' class on mouseenter of a dot. It shows only one card at a time and resets to the last item when the mouse leaves the image. On mobile the card is offset below the dot. 3) Create the snippet ed-product-image-with-video.liquid. It loops product.media in a Swiper gallery and, before each media item, renders the cross-sale snippet if the block's crosssale_position equals the media index and an image is set. Each cross-sale product's coordinates are entered manually as percentages in the theme editor. The setup was recorded in a walkthrough video.

items: Hotspot styling, info-box position (top/bottom/left/right) and offset, and hotspot title/description overrides were requested in the acceptance criteria. The delivered code only has CSS-fixed styling, the product's own title/description, and automatic placement (right on desktop, below on mobile)

dependencies.text: Shopify theme with a main-product section and a Swiper-based product gallery (custom ed-product-image-with-video snippet, theme-specific classes). Cross-sale products are chosen via product settings and positioned with percentage coordinates per item. Tied to a specific theme (dopesnow/Sectionfy). The ticket comments describe the configuration as complex, with a unique value per cross-sale product. The product image is needed for documentation.

items: Click-through rate from hotspot to cross-sale PDP
AOV and items per order on PDP sessions
Gallery slide engagement and swipe depth
